coreAttributes.name: garment freshener
coreAttributes.description: A small spray for freshening one garment. It smells of clean linen.
coreAttributes.applyEffects: [npc.Name] [npc.verb(turn)] it over. It needs a wash before it will do anything.

useDescriptions.selfUse: [npc.Name] [npc.verb(take)] a look at it. It's for a wash.
useDescriptions.otherUse: [npc.Name] [npc.verb(show)] it to [npc2.name]. It's for a wash.
